name: standardise_dep
title: Standardise dependencies using the same logical as install.packages

origin.description: Standardise dependencies using the same logical as install.packages.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The dependencies to standardise. A character vector (selecting from Depends, Imports, LinkingTo, Suggests, or Enhances), or a logical vector.

origin.details: TRUE is shorthand for Depends, Imports, LinkingTo, and Suggests. A length-1 logical NA is shorthand for Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo. FALSE is shorthand for no dependencies. soft means the same as TRUE, and hard means the same as NA. Any additional value that is not one of those five names is dropped, and the names that remain keep the order of x. isTRUE(x) matches a length-1 non-missing logical TRUE. identical(x, NA) and identical(x, FALSE) match only that length-1 value. A numeric missing value raises Dependencies must be a boolean or a character vector. A character NA makes the hard test missing unless some element is hard.
origin.value: A character vector of dependency names. FALSE returns character(0).
origin.example:
cat(paste0("standardise_dep(NA) returns ", paste(standardise_dep(NA), collapse = ", "), ".\n"))
print(standardise_dep(TRUE))
print(standardise_dep(FALSE))
print(standardise_dep(c("Imports", "Suggests")))

translation.description: Standardise dependencies using the same logical as install.packages.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: True, False, the logical NA object, a string, or a list or tuple of strings. None inside that list is a character missing value.

translation.details: True selects Depends, Imports, LinkingTo, and Suggests. The NA object selects Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo. False returns an empty list. A character value selects those three names when any element is hard, otherwise those four when any element is soft, otherwise the names among Depends, Imports, LinkingTo, Suggests, and Enhances, in the order of x, without duplicates. float('nan') and None are not the logical NA, so they raise Dependencies must be a boolean or a character vector. A character missing value raises missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed unless some element is hard.
translation.value: A list of dependency names. False returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from remotes.standardise_dep import NA, standardise_dep
print("standardise_dep(NA) returns " + ", ".join(standardise_dep(NA)) + ".")
print(standardise_dep(True))
print(standardise_dep(False))
print(standardise_dep(["Imports", "Suggests"]))
